## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 的「Renaming or removing a shipped access item」节末新增一段:岗位改名要在新岗位上声明 `renamedFrom: ['old_name']`,不要删了重建;启动时平台在每个组织里把旧名的持有人(`sys_user_position`)挪到新名,幂等;只挪持有人,共享规则/队列/记录共享接收方、待审批人、邀请里的旧名只在启动日志里列给管理员;列出不挪的五种情况。
- 为什么改:PR #33008 给 `PositionSchema` 加了 `renamedFrom`,但对外发布的技能没教,AI 写应用时改岗位名会删了重建,所有持有人静默失去权限集。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文本(+1 changeset),不动代码与 schema;token 天花板未抬,在同一文件里删等量的示例和旁注付账;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 文末新段;其次同文件的付账删减(下方表格逐条列出去处)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep rules/security.md`,预期 `3959 / 3959`,exit 0。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, § Renaming or removing a shipped access item, gains one paragraph, **Renaming a position**:

- declare `renamedFrom: ['old_name']` on the renamed position, never delete and re-add (holders name a position by its bare name, so a deleted one leaves them granted nothing);
- at boot the old name's holders (`sys_user_position`) move to the new name in every organization, idempotently;
- holders only: the boot log lists the old name's other references (sharing-rule, queue and record-share recipients, pending approvers, invitations) for an administrator;
- not carried, warned: an old name still a position anywhere, claimed twice, recorded under another package, switched off, or a disabled claimant.

One changeset, `.changeset/33044-skills-position-renamed-from.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

### Paid in place (token ceiling unchanged)

`rules/security.md` was 15828 bytes (3957 tokens, ceiling 3959, headroom 2) on the merge base `34c05229`; it is now 15834 bytes, 3959 tokens, headroom 0. The card carries no maintainer words that order the text, so no raise; the new paragraph is paid by deletions in the same file:

| Cut | Where the fact still lives |
|---|---|
| `(ADR-0090 D12)` after the delegated-admin clause | ADR-0090 |
| `(explaining another user needs manage_users)` | an operator detail of the explain door, not an authoring rule; its contract is `packages/spec/src/security/explain.zod.ts` |
| `(no read on the roster needed)` on membership keys | "as a system read" in the same sentence says it |
| the `com.acme.crm` / `hd_agent` example of `outside-closure` | eval `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` asks exactly this scenario; the rule sentence stays |
| the `hr` / `ops` / `auditor` example of `ambiguous-in-closure` | illustrative; the install refusal of a second shipper is KEPT (that eval expects it) |
| `Ciphertext lives in sys_secret, only an opaque ref on the row.` | `rules/field-types.md` `secret` row (encrypted at rest, masked, fail-closed, ADR-0100) |
| `e.g. identity tables a plugin writes via its own adapter (sys_sso_provider, OAuth clients)` and `(adapter-written rows often lack it)` | plugin-internal; the rule (a null `organization_id` row is denied) stays |
| `— the list renders empty` | UI symptom of the denial stated beside it |
| `an app-declared default profile, a customer-authored set` | "any set with a wildcard read grant" states the rule; `viewer_readonly` and the `member_default` contrast stay |

Whole-file reading: 327 → 329 lines, 3957 → 3959 tokens. Whole-package reading (every `skills/**/SKILL.md`): unchanged, no `SKILL.md` is touched (4602 lines at the merge base).

## Acceptance notes

Every claim in the paragraph was read from the code on `origin/main` (`34c05229`):

| Claim | Read from |
|---|---|
| `renamedFrom` is a list of earlier position names | `packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` (`renamedFrom`, its JSDoc and `.describe`) |
| own name / repeated entry refused at parse; still-declared and claimed-twice refused per collection | `packages/spec/src/identity/position-renamed-from.ts` (`refuseSelfRenamedFrom`, `refuseDishonestPositionRenamedFrom`) |
| moves holders at boot, as the system, every organization, `position` column only, idempotent | `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` header § What it does |
| the six boot refusals (`claimed-twice`, `claimant-disabled`, `still-declared`, `held-by-other`, `owned-by-other`, `switched-off`), each logged at `warn`, holders left | same file, `PositionRenameRefusal` and `logPositionRenameCarry` |
| other references named, never rewritten: sharing-rule, queue-member and record-share recipients, pending approver slots, pending invitations, activation-ledger rows | same file, header § What it names and never writes, and the `leftBehind` warning |
| deleting the position leaves holders granted nothing | same file, header § Why |

- The code also carries after a marketplace hot install or upgrade (`metadata:reloaded`, #33238); the paragraph says "at boot" only, which always holds, since a reload carries a narrower scope and some install doors do not announce a reload.
- Not taught (detail an author does not act on): a holder who already holds the new name keeps both rows and is warned; a failed row write is retried at the next boot.
- Serial constraints held: this PR does not touch `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` (PR #33394) or `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (PR #33458). No eval added: no existing eval asks about renaming a position.
